cases.name: read_barcode_type_maxicode
cases.flow:
mlxflow 0.8
1. Read Image  label.png
2. Read Barcode  type=maxicode

issues.message: Row 2's `Read Barcode` has `type=maxicode` -- the types are any, qr, code128, ean13, ean8, upca, pdf417, datamatrix, aztec; use one of them.

cases.name: read_barcode_unknown_setting
cases.flow:
mlxflow 0.8
1. Read Image  label.png
2. Read Barcode  type=qr; rotate=yes

issues.message: Row 2's `Read Barcode` doesn't know `rotate=` -- its settings are `type=` (any, qr, code128, ean13, ean8, upca, pdf417, datamatrix, aztec); remove `rotate=`.
